Lemma
[Complete hyperbolic 3-manifolds are irreducible] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0199, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0200 1. ch31:31.13\group 3-manifold topology

Every embedded two-sphere in a complete hyperbolic three-manifold bounds an embedded three-ball.
